name: overflow_test.k
model:
class SignedOverflow {
  overflow:Int = 128
  i8over:Int8 = overflow as Int8
  backOver:Int = i8over as Int

  req backOver = -128
}

main:SignedOverflow
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SignedOverflow (mk-SignedOverflow (overflow Int)(i8over (_ BitVec 8))(backOver Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SignedOverflow (sel-SignedOverflow SignedOverflow))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SignedOverflow ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SignedOverflow (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SignedOverflow ((this Ref)) SignedOverflow
  (sel-SignedOverflow (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SignedOverflow ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SignedOverflow this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -------------------------------------
;   Getters for class SignedOverflow:
; -------------------------------------

; --- getters for SignedOverflow.overflow: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow!overflow ((this Ref)) Int
  (overflow (deref-SignedOverflow this))
)

; --- getters for SignedOverflow.i8over: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow!i8over ((this Ref)) (_ BitVec 8)
  (i8over (deref-SignedOverflow this))
)

; --- getters for SignedOverflow.backOver: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow!backOver ((this Ref)) Int
  (backOver (deref-SignedOverflow this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SignedOverflow (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ---------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SignedOverflow:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SignedOverflow SignedOverflow)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedOverflow!overflow this) 128)
)

(assert (! (SignedOverflow.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedOverflow!i8over this) ((_ int2bv 8) (SignedOverflow!overflow this)))
)

(assert (! (SignedOverflow.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedOverflow!backOver this) (ite (bvslt (SignedOverflow!i8over this) (_ bv0 8)) (- (bv2int (SignedOverflow!i8over this)) 256) (bv2int (SignedOverflow!i8over this))))
)

(assert (! (SignedOverflow.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun SignedOverflow.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedOverflow!backOver this) (- 128))
)

(assert (! (SignedOverflow.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SignedOverflow const-1-SignedOverflow))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-SignedOverflow () SignedOverflow
  (mk-SignedOverflow 128 #x80 (- 128)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 ((_ int2bv 8) (overflow (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))))))
  (= (i8over (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (bvslt (i8over (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))) #x00))
      (a!2 (bv2int (i8over (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))))))
  (= (backOver (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))) (ite a!1 (- a!2 256) a!2))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SignedOverflow a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (overflow (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))) 128))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (backOver (sel-SignedOverflow (select heap 1))) (- 128)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-SignedOverflow (mk-SignedOverflow 128 #x80 (- 128)))))
